standard_prerequisites.name: Extending a rational map across points of codimension one
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, the lemma that a rational map is defined at all points of codimension one when the target is proper and separated
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to the case where the complement of the domain is a finite set of closed points.

standard_prerequisites.name: Extending a rational map after a modification
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, the lemma producing a proper modification over which the rational map is defined
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a proper morphism to the source which is an isomorphism over the domain of the rational map and carries a morphism agreeing with the rational map.

standard_prerequisites.name: Dominating a proper modification by blowups in closed points
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma dominating a proper morphism which is an isomorphism outside a finite set of regular surface points by a sequence of blowups in closed points above that set
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the modification into a sequence of blowups in closed points and provides the composed morphism to the target.

core_obligations: Reduce to a finite complement (proof lines 1185-1192): a rational map into a proper and separated target is defined at every point of codimension one, so one may assume the complement of the domain is a finite set of closed points whose local rings are regular of dimension two.

Modify and factor through blowups (proof lines 1192-1207): the extension lemma gives a proper morphism to the source, an isomorphism over the domain, carrying a morphism to the target agreeing with the rational map; the domination lemma applied to that proper morphism gives a sequence of blowups at closed points not lying over the domain together with a morphism from the last blowup to the modification; the composition with the previously obtained morphism is the required extension.
proof_roadmap: Use extension across codimension one to make the complement finite.
Produce a proper modification over which the rational map is defined.
Dominate that modification by blowups in closed points and compose.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a rational map from a regular two dimensional scheme over a base into a proper scheme over that base becomes a morphism after a sequence of blowups in closed points outside the domain (statement lines 1181-1192). The proof (proof lines 1193-1207) reduces to a finite complement, modifies the source, and dominates the modification by blowups in closed points. H2: a complete three step reduction.
